Name: Nicer Seasonal TV Channels - Update
Author: Chic06
Description:
[size=4]The "Nicer Seasonal TV Chanels" mod was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/megabytebunny]megabytebunny[/url] who gave me permition to reupload it.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/megabytebunny][/url][/size]

[size=4]Some additions were made by me based on the original art made by megabytebunny, adding compatibility with the Island TV Anchor and the Green Rain Anchor so it stays consistent with the regular TV Anchor of each season.[/size]

[center][size=4][b]Weather report anchors rotate each season![/b][/size][/center]

[center][left][b][size=4][url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://emojipedia.org/television]📺[/url]How to Install[/size][/b][/left]
[left][size=4]﻿1. Install the latest ver. of [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size][/left]
[left][size=4]﻿3. Download and extract/unzip this file into your mods folder (or use [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url])[/size][/left]
[left][size=4]﻿4. Run the game through SMAPI.[/size]

[/left]
[left][b][size=4][url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://emojipedia.org/satellite-antenna]📡[/url]Current Compatibility[/size][/b][/left]
[left][size=4]﻿SV 1.6.0+[/size]

[/left]
[left][size=4][url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://emojipedia.org/sun-behind-cloud]⛅[/url][b]Uninstalling[/b][url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250610063839/https://emojipedia.org/sun-behind-cloud][/url][/size][/left]
[left][size=4]﻿Simply delete 'Nicer Seasonal TV Channels' from your mods folder[/size][/left]

[size=4]If there are any issues, please let me know![/size]
[/center]
